sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Receptor expressed and purified as a functional EP2–Gs complex suitable for cryo-EM; no independent functional assay (e.g., cAMP, ligand binding) reported separately for the tagged construct.
sites.rationale: L4 explicitly reports a FLAG tag placed at the N-terminus of full-length membrane-anchored EP2 after replacement of the native signal peptide with an HA signal peptide. The computed topology assigns residues 1–25 as extracellular (EC1) with no signal-peptide designation (raw topology begins 'O'), so the canonical mature N-terminus is M1; the FLAG tag therefore prepends before M1, giving insert_after_residue=0. EC1 (1–25) is the only extracellular terminus of this 7-TM receptor; no residue number is named for the FLAG junction, so position_evidence is topology_derived. Python confirmed res(1)=M and that TM1 begins at residue 26, placing the prepend site >25 residues from any TM boundary. Full-length human EP2 construct used for cryo-EM structural studies of the EP2–Gs complex: native signal peptide replaced with HA signal peptide, followed by a FLAG tag (DYKDDDK) at the N-terminus of the mature receptor, with the membrane-anchored receptor expressed in HEK293 cells for complex purification.

sources.claim: Native signal peptide was replaced with the hemagglutinin signal peptide (HA) to enhance receptor expression, followed by a Flag tag (DYKDDDK) to facilitate the purification of the complex.

literature_notes: Four ledger lines were evaluated. L4 (and corroborating L2) ground the single extracellular site: a FLAG tag at the N-terminus of full-length EP2, used for cryo-EM complex purification. No residue number is named for the FLAG junction, but the N-terminus is the only extracellular terminus of this GPCR, so the position is topology_derived (insert_after_residue=0, prepend before M1). L1 and L3 report a BRIL thermostabilizing domain inserted between ICL3 residues R224 and A257; ICL3 is intracellular (landmarks: 220–263), so this is recorded in other_positions only. L2 describes the same construct as L4 (HA-SP + FLAG at N-terminus + BRIL in ICL3) and adds no new extracellular site. No ledger line supports an insertion in EC2 (92–110), EC3 (177–194), or EC4 (287–297), so no sites are proposed there.

literature_other_positions.note: BRIL thermostabilizing domain inserted between ICL3 residues R224 and A257 (intracellular loop 3, landmarks 220–263) in full-length EP2 for cryo-EM; R224 confirmed as R by sequence lookup.
A257 is the C-terminal junction of the BRIL insertion in ICL3 (linker ERARSTL connects BRIL C-terminus to A257); confirmed as A by sequence lookup; intracellular per landmarks 220–263.
